text:

text:
Raids just landed in solo 'simulated MMO' Erenshor
I wonder if there's simulated ninja looting and DKP arguments.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I used videogames to solve my country's politics: Turns out the answer is ultra-mega-communism
Someone get the government on the phone.

author: PC Gamer
text:
I'm not worried about Fallout: New Vegas 2, because Obsidian knows how to make the best out of a bad situation
Development of the first New Vegas wasn't exactly plain sailing.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The toughest choices in PC games
And what happens when you make them.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Question time: How long have you been playing MMOs?
A new age. Or an old one, depending.

author: PC Gamer
text:
For years, survival games have convinced us that chopping down 400 trees is somehow part of the fantasy—Palworld proves them wrong
With a little help from my Pals.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve reassures Team Fortress 2 players that it's still working on the Mann vs Machine update it announced last year: 'We promise we're making progress'
"It's taking a lot longer to sort through the new content and changes than we'd originally anticipated."

author: PC Gamer
text:
Glass mouse pads haven't won me over but gamer sleeves are a different story
Mock me if you must. My gamer sleeve and I aren't listening.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Get 15 games for $15 in Humble's 2K Megahits bundle, including Bioshock Infinite, Risk of Rain 2, and one of my favourite shooters of all time
Also includes XCOM: Enemy Unknown, Borderlands 3, and Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve says there's no end in sight to the memory crisis, and prices are only going to increase: 'Honestly, it's still getting worse'
Retail availability is lagging bulk supply by "at least three to six months" according to a Valve engineer.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Fallout 5: Confirmed details (and speculation) about Bethesda's next post-nuclear RPG
Bethesda is finally returning to the irradiated wastes.

author: PC Gamer
text:
We just awarded $500 to the PC gamer who sent us this wild Crimson Desert video, and next month it could be you
We're giving away $500 in Amazon gift cards every month, so send in your best gaming clips for a chance to win.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Does anyone know how to drive this thing?
It's increasingly looking like nobody remembers how videogames work—or cares to.

author: PC Gamer
text:
2 months after releasing Zero Parades, Studio ZA/UM is laying off employees: 'Its commercial performance has not enabled us to sustain a studio of our current size'
Up to 32 people will be put out of work.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Hytale releases massive preview of upcoming content including 22 videos and 37 new images
Plus about 4,000 words!

author: PC Gamer
text:
Retiring Valve programmer says 'at least one' of the studio's beloved game modes was made in secret to avoid pushback from peers
Valve's mythical flat corporate structure might be somewhat less than 100% self-directed.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Todd Howard checks his calendar, sighs quietly, and tells us all again that he doesn't have a grudge against Obsidian or Fallout: New Vegas
Say the line, Todd!

author: PC Gamer
text:
How much RAM do you need for an 'ultimate gaming machine?' July in PC Gamer 10, 20, and 30 years ago
Here's what was happening in PC gaming in July 1996, 2006 and 2016.

author: PC Gamer
text:
'We're interested in having the whole PC catalog as our 'launch exclusive'': Valve talks exclusives and the advantages of an open platform
Anyone can make a better Steam machine, and that's how Valve likes it.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blizzard finally caved on Diablo 4's disastrous new season with a patch that reverts almost everything players hated: 'Not every idea lands exactly as intended'
The Season of Death Awakening might actually be saved.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Doom director Hugo Martin says id Software is fine, and anyway, 'what matters the most is that the games are good'
I'm not so sure about that one, man.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Marathon game director leaves Bungie just 4 months after launch: 'I'll be heading to something new, somewhere else'
This is not good news for Bungie, or its only remaining active game.
